title: Search, filter, choose a fare and price it
caption: The M2 journey of `tools/e2e/specs/storefront/search.e2e.ts` against the Amadeus stub (5 offers Madrid → Paris; destination `ZZZ` = none).

steps.title: Fill in the search form
steps.body: One way; From: type `Madrid`, pick **MAD**; To: type `Paris`, pick **PAR**; Departure: a date about 40 days ahead; Search flights.
steps.expect: The combobox lists airports and cities from 2 characters (debounced 250 ms); the field shows "Madrid … (MAD)". Empty fields, same origin and destination, a past date or infants > adults show the focused error summary instead of leaving the page.

steps.title: Results
steps.body: Wait for the results; check the address.
steps.expect: Skeleton cards and "Searching airlines…", then the heading **5 flights**. The address gains `search=srch_…`; a reload shows the same results without a new search. DB: one `flight_searches` row (status `completed`, `result_count` 5) and 5 `flight_offers` rows.

steps.title: Filter and sort
steps.body: Tick **Direct** under stops; Sort by **Cheapest first**.
steps.expect: "4 flights", every card says Direct, the address has `stops=0` and `sort=price`, cards ordered by the API's total. Below 1024 px the filters sit behind "Filters (n)".

steps.title: Open an offer
steps.expect: "Flight details" with bounds, baggage per traveller type, the price box and "Choose your fare": BASIC, CLASSIC, FLEXIBLE (stub upsell) with price differences as the API wrote them.

steps.title: Choose a fare and price it
steps.expect: The address keeps `fare=off_…`; then `/price.html?priced=prc_…` with "Your price", "Fare: FLEXIBLE", a breakdown whose total equals the total box, and "Price held for mm:ss". DB: one `priced_offers` row with `expires_at` about `offer_ttl_minutes` (default 30) ahead.

steps.title: Check the price page details
steps.body: Open **Changes and refunds**; read "What you need to book" and the extras line.
steps.expect: Fare rules at a glance and per category; requirements (names, dates of birth, documents…); "Available in checkout: … from €…" only with `features.ancillaries`. **Continue to checkout** is enabled while the price holds.
